scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names server,web --prefix-colors blue,green "mvn -f apps/server/pom.xml spring-boot:run" "pnpm --filter @open-im/web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @open-im/contracts build && mvn -f apps/server/pom.xml package && pnpm --filter @open-im/web build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @open-im/contracts build && mvn -q -f apps/server/pom.xml -DskipTests compile && pnpm --filter @open-im/web typecheck
scripts.test: mvn -q -f apps/server/pom.xml verify && pnpm --filter @open-im/contracts test && pnpm --filter @open-im/web test
scripts.e2e: docker compose --profile e2e up -d --wait && playwright test
scripts.e2e:ui: docker compose --profile e2e up -d --wait && playwright test --ui
